scope: Implement and review-repair the opt-in literal batched Prefill::run routing seam, phase-specific v2 request-identified binary writer, final-chunk CLI refusals, dynamic short-read override guard, and dependency-free host format contract. The default callback remains null.

implementation.callback: Prefill::on_routing receives actual post-override token-major ids and F32 router weights after each MoE layer's route kernel and before expert execution. Null performs no copy or synchronization.
implementation.paths: The callback is wired into one-shot prefill and every serve prompt-path stage, including layer-split stages. Writes are mutex-serialized because split stages can overlap. Serve opens the trace only after final auto-chunk resolution and fit fallback, immediately before callback installation.
implementation.format: 40-byte little-endian STRP v2 header with phase=1 batched_prefill, followed by 32-byte chunk-record headers carrying uint64 request_id, then token-major int32 ids plus F32 weights. One-shot uses request_id 0; serve lazily allocates the next nonzero ordinal on the first callback of each incoming request that prefills.
implementation.refusals: One-shot use without a multi-token batched prefill refuses startup. Serve use with final short_read >= final prefill_chunk refuses startup. STRATA_PIPELINE_SWITCH short_read overrides are ignored and logged while capture is active; other switch fields remain operative.

checks.result: Dependency-free v2 header, request-id record headers, duplicate (position,layer) across request IDs 1 and 2, true-weight payloads, reserved fields, and rejected-record no-write contract passed.

non_claims: No CUDA, HIP, or SYCL backend was compiled or run; src/prefill/prefill.cpp is shared by CUDA and HIP and still requires both affected-backend builds.
No real model or GPU produced a prefill trace, so literal-path expert coverage, router-weight sums, output parity, and capture overhead remain unmeasured.
The existing prefiller planner still consumes legacy --dump-routing records and does not yet parse this phase-header format.
Exact default-path output identity on real hardware is unmeasured; the source contract claims only that a null callback performs no capture download or synchronization.
The host CMake configure fetched the existing llama.cpp dependency and built only routing_trace_test; no engine target was built.
